r21-6-058.gate_key: rep_statements | B1.2 | gap | Complete with *said* or *told*: Our manager ___ us the office would close at four. |

item.q: Complete with *said* or *told*: Our manager ___ us the office would close at four.
item.why: *tell* needs a person right after it: *told me, told us*. *say* does not: *said (that)…*, or *said to me*.
item.why_lv: Pēc *tell* uzreiz nāk persona: *told me, told us*. Pēc *say* persona nenāk: *said* (*that*)… vai *said to me*. *Tulkojot burtiski* no "teica man", *rodas said me*.
